words.translation: The pleasant, earthy smell after rain
words.sentence1: After the summer storm, the garden was filled with a refreshing petrichor. (After the summer storm, the garden was filled with a refreshing petrichor.)
words.sentence2: She closed her eyes to inhale the earthy petrichor rising from the dry pavement. (She closed her eyes to inhale the earthy petrichor rising from the dry pavement.)

words.sentence1: Me encanta caminar por la ciudad silenciosa en plena madrugada. (I love walking through the silent city in the middle of the early dawn.)
words.sentence2: Salieron de viaje a la madrugada para evitar el tráfico. (They left for their trip at dawn to avoid the traffic.)

words.translation: The joy of reuniting with someone after a long time
words.sentence1: Les retrouvailles à la gare furent pleines de larmes et de sourires. (The reunion at the station was full of tears and smiles.)
words.sentence2: Il y a une émotion particulière dans ces longues retrouvailles familiales. (There is a special emotion in these long family reunions.)

words.translation: A longing for far-off places; homesickness for the unknown
words.sentence1: Beim Anblick der alten Landkarte überkam ihn sofort das Fernweh. (Looking at the old map, wanderlust immediately overcame him.)
words.sentence2: Ihr Fernweh trieb sie dazu, ein One-Way-Ticket nach Asien zu buchen. (Her wanderlust drove her to book a one-way ticket to Asia.)

words.translation: Sunlight filtering through the leaves of trees
words.sentence1: 森の小道で美しい木漏れ日に癒された。 (I was healed by the beautiful sunlight filtering through the trees on the forest path.)
words.sentence2: 木漏れ日の下で読書をするのが一番好きです。 (I love reading books beneath the sunlight filtering through the leaves most of all.)

words.translation: The mark left on a table by a cold, wet glass
words.sentence1: Per favore, usa un sottobicchiere per non lasciare il culaccino sul legno. (Please use a coaster so you don't leave the glass ring on the wood.)
words.sentence2: Il tavolo di marmo era pieno di culaccini dopo la festa. (The marble table was full of glass rings after the party.)

words.translation: Fateful affinity or destiny that brings people together
words.sentence1: 能在异国他乡遇到老同学，真是莫大的缘分。 (To be able to meet an old classmate in a foreign land is truly a wonderful destiny.)
words.sentence2: 他们两个人的相遇充满了缘分。 (The meeting of those two people was full of fateful affinity.)

words.sentence1: 아침 햇살이 너무 눈부셔서 눈을 뜰 수가 없었다. (The morning sunlight was so dazzling that I couldn't open my eyes.)
words.sentence2: 그녀의 환한 미소가 청춘처럼 눈부시게 빛났다. (Her bright smile shone as dazzlingly as youth.)

words.translation: To prosper, flourish, or grow in goodness
words.sentence1: សូមឱ្យគ្រួសាររបស់អ្នកទទួលបាននូវសេចក្តីសុខ និងការចម្រើនรุ่งเรือง។ (May your family attain happiness and prosperity.)
words.sentence2: ប្រទេសជាតិយើងកំពុងតែមានការចម្រើនលើគ្រប់វិស័យ។ (Our nation is developing and flourishing in all sectors.)

words.translation: A scenic view or vista that stretches into the distance
words.sentence1: Die bergtop bied 'n pragtige vergesig oor die hele vallei. (The mountain peak offers a magnificent view over the entire valley.)
words.sentence2: Sy staar verlore in die vergesig terwyl die son sak. (She stared dreamily into the distant vista as the sun set.)
